book.name: DIR PASA
book.title: DIR PASA Dir pasa Yesus Kristusŋge te-mayokna

content: Pino ande mbeŋ suŋgo kulmbaŋ suk ndoŋ mayok kinaik
Kile samba mbolŋge agaŋ kanunu tugu suŋgokanu mayok ka pino ande nu ki tawi taŋaŋ kaika ŋak minna. Nu tambun mbolŋge tiŋ minmba nuŋe gabat mbolŋge nyu ŋak tuku hat mbai 12 ŋak kaika minna.
Nu fuŋgulok minna sulumba nu kiŋo te-palmbim bafumba ŋgaro rar suŋgo tumba witina.
Kile samba mbolŋge agaŋ kanunu ande tugu suŋgokanu ŋak mbeŋ suŋgo kulmbaŋ suk gurgur gabatnu 7 naunu 10 ŋak mayok kina. Nuŋe gabat ŋakmba nyu ŋak tuku hat kaike likanu ŋak minna.

Samba mbolŋge nu mbai kuasmbi ndindo nuŋe dadumbi gureŋmba armba kusrekina. Taŋamba taŋamba mbai ŋakmba mbolŋge kina le kilke mbolŋge ndeke likinaig. Mbeŋ kulmbaŋ suk ta pino ta kiŋo te-pilwa le tumba nyam tuku nu tugum taŋge minna.

Taŋamba minna le kile pino ta kiŋo te-pilna le andeŋge nu pitik ndo didik tumba Kuate tuku minyo mbili maditaknu tugum taŋge pilna. Kiŋo ta suŋgoka nuŋe saŋgri ain ndumndum tambi kilke mbol mbal ŋakmba kulatkamŋgat.
Pino ta kua ka Kuate nu minam tuku ma ma baknu mbolŋge wakeina ta mbol kina ka taŋge nu ki ait 1,260 minna le Kuateŋge nu nyamagaŋ tumba minna.
Kile samba mbolŋge kame suŋgo prona. Eŋel suŋgo Mikael nuŋe kuasmbi kilmba mbeŋ kulmbaŋ suk ta suŋgo ndoŋ kame bunaig. Taŋanaig le mbeŋ ta nuŋe eŋel ŋaigonu kilmba nane ndoŋ kame buna.

Nane kame bunaig ma ma mbeŋ tuku kuasmbi kile-ibeŋka mbeŋ suŋgo tumba nuŋe eŋel ŋaigonu ndoŋ pankinaig le kilke mbol ndeka samba tumbraŋ nduiye kusrenaig. Taŋamba mbeŋ o buk abo abo minna ta nyunu bukla ŋayonu nyunu ande Satan nu taŋgo yabriniŋmba didikate ta nu kilke mbol ndekina.

Kile samba mbolŋge pasa ande kueŋka sakina: Satan nu ki furir mindek Kuate tugumŋge siŋgine tira kilmba pasa mbolŋge patikate ta eŋelŋge nu tumba bukŋginaig le kilke mbol ndekina. Siŋgine Kuate nu kile siŋgine muskil kile-tidiŋga nuŋe saŋgri te-mayokmba nuŋe gageu kulatkate. Nu nuŋe madina taŋgo tuku nyu suŋgo te-mayokte.
Siŋgine tira kame nane naŋgine ŋgarosu mape ndaka kumam kuru kuru ndaka Kuate tuku pasa te-mayokmba Sipsip Fat tuku ndarembi Satan te-ibeŋnaig.

Ta tuku samba mbolŋge minig mbal tane gare-garekap. Kilke le yu mbolŋge minig mbal ose. Tane piti suŋgo tamŋgaig. Satan nuŋe ait kugamba buk fag kinit ta nu kila tukunu nu gubra suŋgo tumba tane tugum ta prote ŋgina.
Mbeŋ kulmbaŋ suk bukŋginaig le kilke mbol ndekina ta wamdus puluna le pino kiŋo te-pilna ta balewam koroŋna.
Koroŋna le Kuateŋge nu buŋga ma ta kusremba ma baknu mbol kumba ka ki ait 1,260 taŋge minwa le Kuateŋge nyamagaŋ tuwa le nyuwa ŋga nu paŋus salmban armba tuna.
Tuna le nu buŋga kina le mbeŋ nu pino te-ŋgisiwam tuku kule kumka furkina le kule suŋgo pinderkate taŋaŋ pino koroŋmba kina.
Kina le kilke puluka pino turna le kule mbeŋŋge kumka furkina ta ka burok sinam ta kumba ka kugana.

Taŋana le mbeŋ kulmbaŋ suk ta nu pino ta tuku gubra suŋgo tumba nu tuku kiŋo kame afu ndoŋ kame buwam saka nane bale faram kina. Nane Kuate tuku pasa ismba dubimba Yesus tuku pasa tugusek biye demba kukliwanu mbal ta nane pino ta tuku kiŋo kame minig.
Kile mbeŋ suŋgo ta nu piyalŋge tiŋ minna le kaŋgeren.
